description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the austine-daily-ops system, then read both `references/daily-ops-templates.md` and `references/transport-procurement.md` to get the exact output templates. (2) Parse `inbox/priorities_inbox.txt` and produce a Daily Brief section using the exact 4-part structure: Top 3 Priorities (numbered), Next 72h Critical Deadlines/Reminders, Automation Suggestion + Quick Win (<15 min), and a 'Next Action I'll Take' closing line — all bullet-first. (3) Parse `inbox/trip_request.txt` and produce a trip logistics section that: sources public transport first (KTM/ERL/shuttle) before private options, formats each option using all 6 normalized quote fields (provider, price+currency, inclusions, exclusions, cancellation terms, pickup/drop details, confidence/risk note), flags all uncertain prices as 'estimated' or 'unconfirmed', generates exactly three recommendation categories (Best Value, Best Convenience, Best Fallback) each with a one-line trade-off, and ends with an explicit 'Option A / Option B / Option C' decision handoff question. (4) Produce a vendor follow-up pending list from inbox items (KL Lightworks quote, Ahmad Catering headcount, BrightShield insurance certificate) with owner and due date columns, and mention the day-before reminder/escalation rule. All output goes into `daily_ops_package.md`.
